Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms

Class SmsCostPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms.SmsCostPolicy
public final class SmsCostPolicy extends Object
The rules that keep text messages from costing too much: the countries messages may go to, what a message costs in each and the budget per window and per day. It is pure: the spend is kept by a SmsCostLedgerRepository.

  • Constructor Details

    • SmsCostPolicy

      public SmsCostPolicy(Set<String> allowedCountries, Map<String,Long> costMicrosByCountry, long defaultCostMicros, Duration window, long windowCapMicros, long dailyCapMicros)
      Creates the policy.
      Parameters:
      allowedCountries - countries that may receive messages; empty allows none.
      costMicrosByCountry - cost of a message per country; not negative values.
      defaultCostMicros - cost of a message to an allowed country that has none of its own; not negative.
      window - length of the short window; positive.
      windowCapMicros - budget of the short window; not negative.
      dailyCapMicros - budget of a day; not negative.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a value is missing, a country is not an ISO alpha-2 code, or a cost, cap or the window is out of range.
